settings.title: HOW DO I SIGN UP?
settings.description: Complete the sign-up information form below and sign our Challenge terms & conditions and photo release waiver. Obagi Medical will select 20 participants to complete the challenge. No purchase necessary to enter.

settings.title: WHAT DO I HAVE TO DO?
settings.description: Once accepted into the Challenge, you’ll receive 1 (one) Obagi Nu-Derm® Fx System Kit and 1 (one) Obagi Retinol. Participating in this Challenge requires you to use this skincare system twice daily for 16 weeks AND track your progress by taking 5 images of your skincare journey using the Obagi Transformation Tracker filter on Instagram®.

settings.title: HOW LONG IS THE CHALLENGE & WHAT DO I GET?
settings.description: The Challenge begins the week of December 2nd, 2024, lasting for 16 weeks and ending in April 2025. You will receive 1 (one) Obagi Nu-Derm® Fx System Kit and 1 (one) Obagi Retinol basedon your skin type (Normal to Dry or Normal to Oily) complementary.

settings.title: THE OBAGI NU-DERM COMMITMENT
settings.description:
Transform your skin with Obagi, the US’s #1 physician-recommended brand for hyperpigmentation* and one of the world’s leading solutions since 1988.  The Nu-Derm Fx System is a clinically proven, step-by-step skincare regimen formulated to transform skin by significantly reducing the appearance of dark spots and post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation on the skin.

The Obagi Nu-Derm Before & After Challenge is 16-week before & after photo tracking challenge using the Obagi Nu-Derm® Fx System + Retinoid twice daily and tracking results with the Obagi Transformation Tracker filter on Instagram®.


*Source: Kline’s Physician-Dispensed Skin Care Survey 2023

For 35 years, we’ve proudly pioneered transformational skincare. From being the first brand to clinically test our products on all skin types and tones, to setting the gold standard for medical-grade skincare with our Obagi® Nu-Derm® and Professional-C® lines, our breakthroughs raised the bar for the entire skincare industry. But true innovators never rest. We’re looking forward to achieving even greater levels of skincare excellence in the years ahead.

Our growing portfolio brings you effective and transformative solutions for every step of your skin care journey.

No matter your skin type, skin tone, age or gender, there’s an Obagi product for you. Let us help you find the right skin care products to target your specific skin type and concern.

settings.heading: Obagi is committed to delivering the next era in skincare.

settings.question: How do I sign up?
settings.answer: The challenge is 2 phases: Recruitment and Participation. Sign up happens during the Recruitment phase via your Obagi Rep. To sign up, you’ll need to identify a patient participant that can commit to a 16-week skincare journey and submit a patient-signed waiver & release of liability and photography/video consent forms.

settings.question: How are accounts selected to participate?
settings.answer: The first 15 accounts to sign up will be selected. Entries are limited to a total of 15 participants with a submission deadline of November 13, 2024.

settings.question: Are there any costs to me/my practice?
settings.answer: No purchase is necessary to enter the challenge.

settings.question: How is the winner selected?
settings.answer: The winner is selected based on the skin transformation of their patient participant over 16 weeks using Obagi Nu-Derm® by a panel.

settings.question: What does the patient participant win?
settings.answer: The patient participant will win a $1,500 credit of their choice of Obagi Medical products.

settings.question: What if I don’t carry Obagi Nu-Derm® Rx?
settings.answer: Accounts that do not carry Obagi Nu-Derm® Rx can still participate by simply getting set up via Boxout by submitting their medical license.
